sandbox_codebase/labbridge/__init__.py.module_doc: LabBridge: a fictional, simplified instrument-to-LIS middleware used as a demo codebase.

sandbox_codebase/labbridge/astm_parser.p.module_doc: Parse simplified ASTM E1394-style records sent by an analyzer.

ASTMParseError.doc: Raised when a record cannot be parsed.

parse_test_code.doc: Extract the test code from a universal test ID like '^^^GLU'.

parse_reference_range.doc: Turn '3.9 to 6.1' into (3.9, 6.1). Returns None if the field is empty.

parse_result_record.doc: Parse one 'R' record into a result dictionary.

parse_message.doc: Parse a full ASTM message. Returns {'patient_id': str|None, 'results': [..]}.

sandbox_codebase/labbridge/hl7_export.py.module_doc: Build a simplified HL7 v2.5 ORU^R01 (observation result) message for the LIS.

build_oru_r01.doc: Only released results should be passed in; held results never leave LabBridge.

sandbox_codebase/labbridge/qc_rules.py.module_doc: Westgard quality-control rules applied to a run of QC measurements.

check_qc_run.doc: Return a list of violations like {'rule': '1-3s', 'severity': 'reject', 'index': 2}.

qc_status.doc: Summarize a QC run as 'pass', 'warning' or 'reject'.

sandbox_codebase/labbridge/result_valida.module_doc: Decide whether a patient result can be auto-released to the LIS or must be held for review.

range_flag.doc: Return 'L', 'H' or 'N' against a (low, high) reference range; None if no range.
